main_topics.reason: User opened asking what else exists beyond the failing pill and spent most turns comparing progestin, coil and GnRH options.
Pain creeping back, worst in the pill-free week, is the trigger for the whole conversation.
User asked if there is anything besides hormones and engaged with pain service and pelvic floor physio.
After being discharged to the GP post-surgery, user learned to ask for gynaecology re-referral and physio access over a few turns.
User asked if GnRH treatment is as bad as it sounds and was reassured.
User wanted the whole picture before going back to the GP and summarised a list at the end.
User said in one turn that being discharged to the GP felt rubbish given where disease was found.
User briefly voiced being tired of everything being about hormones.
User asked once whether pelvic floor physio would need to be private.

output.summary: User with endometriosis whose combined pill has stopped controlling pain asked about other options before returning to the GP. The bot suggested running the pill continuously, explained progestin, Mirena and GnRH options, noted the disease location near the bowel and ovary, and covered non-hormonal approaches, re-referral and pelvic floor physio. User ended with a clear list of things to raise and said they felt less stuck.
